name: Location
definition: Entity A is located in, at, or on Entity B.

name: Part-Whole
definition: Entity A is a component, division, or subsidiary of Entity B.

name: Membership/Affiliation
definition: Entity A is a member of, employed by, or affiliated with Entity B.

name: Creator/Author
definition: Entity A created, designed, composed, or directed Entity B.

name: Publisher/Distributor
definition: Entity A published, released, or distributed Entity B.

name: Family Relationship
definition: Entity A is related to Entity B by blood, marriage, or partnership.

name: Award/Nomination
definition: Entity A won, received, or was nominated for Entity B.

name: Event Participation
definition: Entity A participated in, competed at, or won Entity B.

name: Identity/Attribute
definition: Entity A is an instance, type, nationality, profession, or code of Entity B.

name: Leadership/Representation
definition: Entity A is the political leader, head, or representative of Entity B.

name: Geographical Feature
definition: Entity A is a body of water flowing into, a tributary of, or geographically adjacent to Entity B.

name: Media Platform
definition: Entity A is broadcast on, runs on, or is compatible with Entity B.

name: Content/Subject
definition: Entity A features, depicts, or is about Entity B.

name: Venue
definition: Entity A is the home ground, stadium, or venue for Entity B.

name: Ownership/Acquisition
definition: Entity A owns, acquired, or purchased Entity B.

name: Predecessor/Successor
definition: Entity A preceded, succeeded, or was replaced by Entity B.

name: Related Entity
definition: Entity A is a version, translation, or conceptually related to Entity B.

name: Temporal Relation
definition: Entity A is a time point or period associated with Entity B.
